title: Sequence full bleed moments, do not alternate
intent: Tell one continuous story across screens so the page reads as a single arc.
when_to_use: the page's job is atmosphere, place, or a narrative order the reader follows
the content ships with strong imagery or long form media
when_not_to_use: the reader arrives to extract a fact or compare options
the media is weak or borrowed, where full bleed amplifies the weakness
rules: no more than two consecutive sections use the same media plus text alternation
each moment states its own idea once, and a screen with no idea is cut
text over media reaches a contrast ratio of 4.5 to 1 against the lightest region of the media it covers
a page with five or more sections uses at least three distinct families and never repeats one in adjacent sections
trade_off: Full bleed constrains type placement, eats the performance budget, and demands real media, so a page holding placeholder imagery cannot ship in this family.
failure_mode: Every section goes full bleed, so nothing is emphasised, and the reader passes four equally loud screens with no memory of any of them.

example.brief: Launch page for a hardware product with real photography.
example.ruling: Four full bleed moments, each with one idea and one caption, then a split-asymmetric specifications section and a single column compatibility list, so no family repeats adjacently.
